annotations.title: Reply to anything in the inbox

description: Use this when the user wants to answer a comment, review, mention or message from the inbox. Pass its composite id — the `id` list_inbox returned, e.g. 'facebook:123_456' or 'google_business:accounts/1/locations/2/reviews/3'. Routes to the right channel for you; you do not need to know which reply tool a platform uses. The reply is posted as the brand — PUBLIC on every comment, reply, mention and review (a Discord mention is answered with a reply in its channel), and PRIVATE on the DM sources (Slack and Discord DMs too), WhatsApp, LINE, Intercom (it goes to the customer from the brand's support inbox) and email (it goes in the same thread from the same Outlook mailbox) — so show the user the exact wording and get their go-ahead first either way. On X a reply is a new post, so it goes through post_to_x with replyTo; an X or Telegram DIRECT MESSAGE is answered here, from the account or bot it reached (an X DM reply costs credits). A WhatsApp reply goes out only while the 24-hour window is open (windowOpen on the item); after that WhatsApp accepts only an approved template, so the reply is refused for free and send_whatsapp_message with `template` is the way. A LINE reply is free inside a minute of their message and uses the account's LINE quota after it.

attachments.description: Messenger / Instagram DMs only: media, same shape as reply_to_meta_message

buttons.description: Messenger / Instagram DMs only: up to 3 buttons, same shape as reply_to_meta_message

contacts.description: WhatsApp only: contact cards (up to 20) instead of text

id.description: The composite id from list_inbox — '<source>:<platform id>'. A bare platform id is refused: replying to the wrong network as the brand cannot be taken back.

location.description: WhatsApp only: a map pin instead of text

media.description: WhatsApp only: one file instead of text, e.g. a voice note {type:"audio", url, voice:true} or a WebP sticker. On Messenger / Instagram a voice note is attachments [{url, type:"audio"}].

voice.description: audio: true sends it as a voice note (an OPUS .ogg)

quickReplies.description: Messenger / Instagram DMs only: up to 13 chips, same shape as reply_to_meta_message

sticker.description: Instagram DMs only: the heart sticker (Messenger documents no sticker a business can send)

text.description: The reply, exactly as it should appear publicly.
